payload.reason: The evidence indicates that zero-shot transfer from RXR to R2R is possible, as demonstrated by the performance of the CLEAR-zero method on the R2R dataset.

claims.text: Zero-shot transfer from RXR to R2R is feasible as shown by the CLEAR-zero method's performance.
The CLEAR method utilizes language and visual representation from the RXR dataset for zero-shot transfer to R2R.
